# Nexus Launcher v0.1.0-alpha

Nexus Launcher is a native desktop launcher for the Straconis tool suite. It reads a local catalog (`catalog/apps.toml`), asks the public GitHub API for each tool's latest release, installs a build under your user account, and starts it from a dark card grid titled **NEXUS LAUNCHER**. It does not need a GitHub token.

This is an alpha. The window, catalog parser, and install paths are in place. The seeded tools do not have releases yet, so their cards stay on **COMING SOON**.

## Assets

| File | Platform |
| --- | --- |
| `nexus-launcher-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux x86_64 portable build |
| `nexus-launcher-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows x86_64 portable build |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 for the two archives above |

The **Source code** archives GitHub adds automatically are the repository snapshot, not a packaged program. There is no macOS binary in this alpha: macOS code paths exist and have pure unit tests, and this tag was not built or GUI-tested on macOS.

Check the archives before you unpack them:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
```

On Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\nexus-launcher-linux-x86_64.tar.gz -Algorithm SHA256
Get-FileHash .\nexus-launcher-windows-x86_64.zip -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the hashes with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## How to run

### Linux (x86_64)

```bash
tar -xzf nexus-launcher-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
cd nexus-launcher-linux-x86_64
./nexus-launcher --check
./nexus-launcher
```

`--check` prints the catalog and exits. It does not open a window and does not call GitHub.

This binary is built on Ubuntu 22.04. It needs **glibc 2.35 or newer** (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, or newer) and **OpenSSL 3** (`libssl.so.3` and `libcrypto.so.3`). The window also needs a desktop session with OpenGL and either X11 or Wayland. Those GUI libraries are loaded when the window starts; they are not linked into the binary. On Debian or Ubuntu:

```bash
sudo apt-get install -y libssl3 libgl1 libx11-6 libxi6 libxcursor1 libxrandr2 \
  libxinerama1 libxkbcommon0 libxkbcommon-x11-0 libwayland-client0 \
  libwayland-cursor0 libwayland-egl1 libegl1
```

There is no AppImage in this alpha. The download is a `.tar.gz` of the binary plus `catalog/apps.toml`.

### Windows (x86_64)

Unzip `nexus-launcher-windows-x86_64.zip`, open that folder, and run `nexus-launcher.exe`. From a terminal in the same folder:

```bat
nexus-launcher.exe --check
nexus-launcher.exe
```

The build uses the MSVC toolchain with the C runtime linked statically, so the Visual C++ redistributable is not required. There is no MSI in this alpha. The executable is unsigned. Windows SmartScreen may warn and ask you to keep the file anyway.

### Catalog next to the program

Leave `catalog/apps.toml` in the `catalog` folder beside the executable. The launcher looks there when the file is not in the working directory. Edit that file and press **REFRESH** to add a tool. You do not recompile the launcher.

## Known alpha limits

- **No system tray** and no launch-at-login. v0.1.0-alpha is a window you open when you want it.
- **Installer hand-off only.** MSI, DMG, deb, and setup executables are downloaded and opened with the operating system (`OPEN INSTALLER`). The launcher does not run them silently, does not elevate, and does not know whether the system installer finished. **LAUNCH** is only for portable files and archives the launcher unpacked itself.
- **COMING SOON** until the app repositories publish a release. The seeded cards are Stat Tracker, SnipScratch, SnapLapse, and FrameWeaver. A repository with no release, and a missing repository, both show **COMING SOON** because requests are unauthenticated.
- **No code signing**, notarization, or SmartScreen reputation.
- **SHA-256 for tools the launcher installs** runs only when that tool's GitHub release publishes a digest or a checksum file. This launcher's own archives are covered by `SHA256SUMS.txt` on this page.
- **GitHub rate limit.** Unauthenticated calls use `User-Agent: nexus-launcher/0.1` and share the 60 requests per hour budget for your IP.
- **Archives.** zip and `.tar.gz` are unpacked. `tar.bz2`, `tar.xz`, and `tar.zst` are recognized and refused.
- **AppImage tools** installed later still need a working AppImage runtime (FUSE or an extracted runtime) on the host. This launcher does not bundle one.
- **Replacing a running portable build** can fail when the OS locks the file. That is common on Windows.

## Build from source

Rust **1.99.1** is pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Straconis/nexus-launcher.git
cd nexus-launcher
git checkout v0.1.0-alpha
cargo run --release
```

Linux compile dependencies:

```bash
sudo apt-get install -y pkg-config libssl-dev libgtk-3-dev \
  libx11-dev libxi-dev libxcursor-dev libxrandr-dev libxinerama-dev \
  libxcb-render0-dev libxcb-shape0-dev libxcb-xfixes0-dev \
  libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libgl1-mesa-dev
```

`cargo run -- --check` parses the catalog without a window. See `README.md` for the catalog format, install roots, and the rest of the layout.

Tagged releases are built by `.github/workflows/release.yml`.
